exposure: Failed TOLAC requiring emergency repeat cesarean section
Successful vaginal birth after cesarean section (VBAC)
previous one lower segment caesarean section (LSCS)
Trial of labor after cesarean section (TOLAC)
cohort: 367 pregnant women with a history of one previous lower segment cesarean section
finding: Among women with a history of one previous cesarean section, 59.37% who attempted TOLAC had a successful vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: The study examined the success rate of trial of labor (TOL) in women with a previous cesarean section, finding that 59.37% of those who attempted TOL had a successful vaginal birth.
